refnamediv.refpurpose: Sets write file buffering on the given stream

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
stream
The file pointer.
size
The number of bytes to buffer. If size is 0 then write operations are unbuffered. This ensures that all writes with fwrite are completed before other processes are allowed to write to that output stream.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns 0 on success, or -1 if the request cannot be honored. A stream opened with fopen (a plain file), tmpfile, php://memory, a socket or a directory handle always gives -1, whereas popen streams, STDIN, STDOUT, STDERR and user-space wrappers whose streamWrapper::stream_set_option returns &true; give 0.
